title: KIAA1549::BRAF is cleaved and located at a membrane
projectDescription: We used a Terminal Amine Isotopic Labelling of Substrates (TAILS) mass spectrometry approach to investigate peptides with a neo-N-terminus of the C-terminally HA-tagged fusion protein KIAA1549::BRAF.
sampleProcessingProtocol: For TAILS experiments, HEK293T cells were transfected with the pMIBerry KB16/9 plasmid and lysed in NLB 48 h later. Next, 30 µL of Anti-HA Affinity Matrix (Roche) was added to 900 µL of cleared lysates and incubated in a rotator at 4 °C for 4 h.  Samples were treated according to Kleifeld et at. (2011). Briefly, proteins were denatured in presence of 6 M GndHCl in HEPES pH 7.8, reduced with 1 mM DTT and alkylated with 5.5 mM IAA. N-terminal and lysine side chain amines were blocked by dimethylation using formaldehyde and sodium cyanoborohydride. After acetone precipitation, proteins were resuspended and digested with trypsin overnight. Newly formed N-terminal free peptides were bound overnight to HPG-ALDII polymer in the presence of sodium cyanoborohydride. Unbound blocked peptides were recovered by passing samples through 30 kD molecular weight cut-off spin-filters and filtrates were desalted using STAGE tip.
dataProcessingProtocol: MS raw files were analysed using MaxQuant (version 2.0.1.0) using a customized database containing the KIAA1549::BRAF 16/9 protein sequence together with a UniProt full-length human database and common contaminants, such as keratins and enzymes used for digestion, as reference using semispecific ArgC as enzyme specificity. Carbamidomethylcysteine and dimethylation of lysine were set as fixed modification and protein amino-terminal acetylation, oxidation of methionine and dimethylation of peptide N-termini were set as variable modifications. The MS/MS tolerance was set to 20 ppm. Peptide, site, and protein FDR based on a forward-reverse database were set to 0.01, and minimum number of peptides for identification of proteins was set to one, which must be unique. The “match-between-run” option was used with a time window of 0.7 min
